subject.title: fix(cerebras): prefer current Gemma 4 onboarding default

question: Should fresh Cerebras setup use the vendor-recommended public-preview Gemma 4 31B model as its default instead of the prior production GPT OSS 120B model?
rationale: The branch changes a user-visible onboarding policy and explicitly documents a capability-versus-availability tradeoff; source review cannot determine the preferred product posture.

options.title: Adopt Gemma 4 for fresh setup
options.body: Use the newer multimodal model for defaultless Cerebras onboarding while preserving all existing primary selections.

options.title: Retain the production default
options.body: Keep GPT OSS 120B as the default until the preferred model has production availability commitments.

recommendation.title: Adopt Gemma 4 for fresh setup
recommendation.body: Use the newer multimodal model for defaultless Cerebras onboarding while preserving all existing primary selections.
